memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Depression
  Status: PHQ-9 10, mild symptoms, reports low mood and anhedonia.
  Plan: Continue sertraline 50 mg OD, add psychotherapy referral, monitor suicidality.
- Hypertension
  Status: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 68 kg, waist 82 cm (>80 cm cut-off).
  Plan: Continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, advise low-salt diet, recheck BP in 4 weeks.
- Rheumatoid arthritis
  Status: Joint pain 2/10, morning stiffness 30 min, ESR 18 mm/h, CRP 6 mg/L.
  Plan: Continue methotrexate 10 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD, consider adding sulfasalazine if flare.
- Diet
  Breakfast: Whole grain toast with avocado, no added sugar.
  Lunch: Mixed vegetable salad with grilled chicken, olive oil dressing.
  Dinner: Lentil soup, steamed broccoli, small portion brown rice.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05.
